method: Read all 360 anonymous prompts and 96-byte continuations in six batches of 60. Model/seed identity key was opened only after scores were saved and locked.
independence: Reviewer also implemented the models; exploratory assistant review, not an independent human study.
criterion: Whole-continuation readability/consistency/prompt connection. Isolated familiar words do not make a gibberish continuation usable.
